brand.name: Welcome East Gwillimbury
brand.legal_name: Welcome East Gwillimbury Media & Community Retention
brand.tagline: Local Discovery, Community Connection & Resident Perks
brand.headquarters: Town of East Gwillimbury, Ontario, Canada
brand.industry: Local Community Media, Civic Technology & Merchant Marketplace
brand.mission: To welcome new residents, champion independent local merchants, and connect East Gwillimbury households with weekly community events, town discoveries, and exclusive local perks.
brand.vision: To become East Gwillimbury's most trusted civic front door—uniting newcomers, long-time residents, and hometown businesses through thoughtful storytelling and high-value local rewards.

logo.description: Two-part heritage lockup: 'WELCOME' set in East Gwillimbury Sage uppercase serif, followed by 'East Gwillimbury' in flowing Heritage Terracotta calligraphy.

wordmark_prefix.style: Spaced Small Caps / Classical Heritage Serif

wordmark_main.style: Elegant Signature Script / Humanist Italic Calligraphy

logo.clearspace: Minimum 24px or 0.5x the height of the 'W' glyph on all four sides.

permitted: Display on clean white, crisp snow, or soft linen backgrounds (#FFFFFF, #F8FAFC, #FFFBEB)
Reverse monochrome white lockup on Deep Midnight Slate (#0F172A) or Cheerful Navy (#00008B)
Maintain original aspect ratio and generous horizontal breathing room
prohibited: Never stretch, skew, rotate, or distort the logo proportions
Never place on busy, clashing, or low-contrast photographic backgrounds without a scrim
Never substitute unapproved neon, pastel, or gradient fills on the wordmark
Never separate 'East Gwillimbury' from 'WELCOME' without explicit brand sign-off

brand_voice.core_archetype: The Welcoming Civic Neighbor & Trusted Hometown Curator

tone_attributes.description: Approachable, kind, and enthusiastic without being loud. We make newcomers feel immediately at home in East Gwillimbury.
Accurate dates, verified addresses, real town updates, CASL-compliant privacy, and trustworthy merchant relationships.
Proudly local. We celebrate East Gwillimbury's beaches, heritage farms, Keswick cafes, and Sutton artisan workshops.
Direct pricing, transparent terms, instant calendar exports, zero clutter, and friction-free digital perk redemption.

do: Mention specific East Gwillimbury hamlets (Keswick, Sutton, Jackson's Point, Pefferlaw, Udora).
Highlight free and family-friendly activities clearly so parents can plan weekends easily.
Include prices, discounts, exact hours, and wheelchair/stroller accessibility details.
Champion independent mom-and-pop stores, tradespeople, and community volunteer groups.
dont: Never publish vague event dates without exact days, times, and venue addresses.
Never employ bait-and-switch deals or unverified claims.
Avoid cynicism or political divisiveness—we exist to bring the community together.

key_phrases: Claim Your Resident Digital Perk Pass

target_audiences.profile: Families and couples who recently relocated to East Gwillimbury from the GTA or elsewhere, seeking trusted local dentists, mechanics, schools, parks, and retail favorites.
target_audiences.value_delivered: Curated Welcome Hamper loaded with physical gifts, verified digital perk passes, town survival guides, and garbage/recycling schedules.

target_audiences.profile: Long-time residents looking for things to do this weekend, community meat draws, live music, holiday parades, library workshops, and local store sales.
target_audiences.value_delivered: Two-week calendar, 6-week town planner, mobile digital wallet, and Thursday morning weekly community newsletter.

target_audiences.profile: Retailers, restaurants, contractors, and service providers seeking direct, qualified local resident reach without spending thousands on social media ads.
target_audiences.value_delivered: Guaranteed welcome pack distribution to verified new movers, sponsored weekend spotlight ad cards, free community sale postings, and cashier redemption verification.

target_audiences.profile: Legion branches, libraries, historical societies, BIA associations, sports clubs, and festival committees.
target_audiences.value_delivered: Free automated event scraping, rapid community event submissions, .ics calendar exports, and wide distribution.

imagery_and_art_direction.style: Bright, authentic, lakeside community lifestyle photography. High natural daylight, crisp waterscapes, real people, and genuine local storefronts.
motifs: East Gwillimbury shorelines, docks, and beach sunsets (Jackson's Point, De La Salle)
Charming High Street historic brick storefronts in Sutton and bustling Keswick plazas
Autumn harvest markets, winter skating at East Gwillimbury Ice Palace, and summer festival fairs
Fresh bakery goods, artisan crafts, hardware tools, and family garden centre visits
avoid: Sterile stock photos with non-Canadian architecture
Overly stylized CGI illustrations that lose touch with small-town warmth
